description: This file contains the implementation of a session handler class for AWS DynamoDB, allowing PHP sessions to be stored and managed within DynamoDB tables. It includes methods for opening, closing, reading, writing, destroying sessions, and handling garbage collection.

classes.name: SessionHandler
classes.description: A PHP class that implements session management using AWS DynamoDB as the backend store. It manages session lifecycle events such as open, close, read, write, destroy, and garbage collection, leveraging DynamoDB operations.

methods.name: fromClient
methods.description: Factory method to create a SessionHandler instance with a DynamoDbClient and configuration options, optionally enabling session locking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the session handler with a given session connection.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the session handler to be used by PHP's session management.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a new session for writing, setting save path and session name.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session, ensuring data is written and unlocked.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from DynamoDB, invalidating expired sessions.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to DynamoDB, tracking if data has changed.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Placeholder for garbage collection, which must be handled manually.

methods.name: garbageCollect
methods.description: Manually triggers deletion of expired sessions.

methods.name: formatId
methods.description: Formats session ID by prepending session name for storage in DynamoDB.
